meta.title: Bounded cross-repo activation contract and protected validation repair
meta.author: manager

feature.problem_statement: Infra PR #1078 and runner-config PR #44 disagree on activation evidence schema and network contract, while protected pull_request_target validation must safely prepare reviewed inputs without executing candidate-controlled code with credentials or network access.
goals: Align producer and consumer to infra evidence schema 1.3.0, canonical digest sha256:419f604a8be41d174b981067eb2c603db56980abb9a62d37a20553fca83d1a63, and exact network contract digest/revision with producer-only evidence and mutation rejection.
Make protected validation base-controlled, immutable-input, candidate-secretless, and network-isolated while preserving exact-head and pin handoffs.
Validate and push only the two owned PR branches without merge, dispatch, deployment, secret, Nexus-bypass, or cluster mutation.
non_goals: Merging PR #1078, #44, #27, or any prerequisite PR.
Changing GitHub settings, secrets, runners, Nexus, Vault, Kubernetes, Argo CD, or deployment state.
Adding compatibility aliases or supporting legacy contract versions.
scope_in: codicarium/infra PR #1078 branch codex/arc-bootstrap-infra from exact starting head 6dd8f3b6d5be342f8c49d01d8f77b3edad385aaf
codicarium/runner-config PR #44 branch codex/issue-1078-activation-contract from current starting head 729ad180aa237d9b8b61f121a133306f922c82fb
Existing separate worktrees, governing documentation, tests, actionlint, policy checks, exact-head CI evidence, and dependency/issue tracking
scope_out: Other branches or PR implementation, including prerequisite base-workflow PRs beyond dependency sequencing and reporting.
Live environment operations and external artifact/credential remediation.

requirements.statement: Runner-config verification MUST accept only the infra-owned evidence schema version 1.3.0 and canonical schema digest sha256:419f604a8be41d174b981067eb2c603db56980abb9a62d37a20553fca83d1a63, with no compatibility aliases.
requirements.rationale: A single producer-consumer schema prevents ambiguous evidence interpretation.

requirements.statement: The consumer MUST enforce the exact infra network contract digest and revision, accept producer evidence only, and reject candidate mutations, replay, extra inventory, unsafe peers, and newline/canonical-byte violations.
requirements.rationale: Activation evidence must be provenance-bound and mutation-resistant.

requirements.statement: Infra protected validation MUST prepare immutable reviewed inputs in protected base-controlled code, then run candidate validation without secrets and with network denied or isolated; candidate files are data and cannot select the runner, alter the harness, or self-authenticate.
requirements.rationale: pull_request_target preparation must not execute untrusted candidate code on a credentialed/networked trusted self-hosted runner.

requirements.statement: Pins, runner/config handoff revisions, and prerequisite sequencing MUST be exact, auditable, and safe for pull_request_target base semantics.
requirements.rationale: Cross-repo validation is only meaningful when every reviewed input is immutable and dependency order is explicit.

requirements.statement: All relevant tests, actionlint, policy/static checks, and exact-head CI evidence MUST be run and reported; only the two owned PR branches may be pushed.
requirements.rationale: The lane requires reproducible evidence without merging or changing runtime state.

acceptance_criteria.scenario: Given an infra-produced 1.3.0 evidence payload with the canonical 419f digest, when runner-config verifies it, then verification proceeds; any other version/digest or alias is rejected.

Given exact network contract revision/digest and canonical payload bytes, when evidence or fixtures mutate producer fields, network inventory, or trailing newline state, then verification fails closed with a focused negative test.

Given a pull_request_target event, when protected validation runs, then only base-controlled code with credentials/network prepares immutable data; candidate validation receives no secrets and runs in a network-denied/isolated context with candidate content treated as data.
Given the two existing worktrees, when checks and pushes complete, then exact branch heads, dependency order, check results, and external gates are reported without merging or runtime mutation.

test_plan.approach: Run runner-config unit tests and focused schema/network/canonical-byte/mutation/replay negative tests against infra schema fixtures.
Run actionlint and protected-boundary/policy tests proving base-controlled selector/harness, secretless candidate phase, immutable artifact bindings, and no candidate self-authentication.
Run infra and runner-config repository validation suites, inspect exact-head PR checks, and verify branch heads after push.

review_checks: Compare runner verifier constants and fixture schema to infra producer schema bytes.
validation_checks: Runner unit and policy tests pass with 1.3.0/419f contract.

review_checks: Inspect exact network revision/digest and mutation rejection paths.
validation_checks: Focused negative tests reject producer-field/network/newline mutations.

review_checks: Audit pull_request_target workflow and job boundary for credential/network separation.
Verify exact pins, base semantics, prerequisite PR/issue sequence.
validation_checks: GitHub exact-head checks and post-push refs are recorded.

review_checks: Confirm only owned branches changed and no live mutation occurred.
validation_checks: Full requested checks and explicit external blockers reported.

perspectives.summary: Keep infra and runner-config edits disjoint, preserve existing worktrees, and sequence any protected-base prerequisite before exact-head validation.
Treat pull_request_target and self-hosted preparation as a high-risk trust boundary; require candidate secretless/network-isolated execution and immutable reviewed inputs.
Require focused negative tests for schema/network/canonical bytes/mutations plus actionlint, policy checks, and exact-head post-push evidence.

council.consensus_summary: Proceed only with exact producer-consumer alignment and a fail-closed protected validation design; do not use aliases, fallback artifacts, merges, or live mutations.
open_questions: Whether merged base workflow semantics require a prerequisite PR before #1078 can obtain a trustworthy exact-head protected check; resolve from current infra main and existing tracked issue/PR state.
